title: Yeh Hai Chakkad Bakkad Bumbe Bo
original_title: Yeh Hai Chakkad Bakkad Bumbe Bo
overview: What happens when you put four mischievous children together with a dog and a monkey? Lots of fun, of course! And that's what 'Chhakkad Bakkad Bumbe Bo' (The Sensational Six) is all about - fun, adventure and learnings.
